_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Sir E. A. Wallis Budge (1857-1934), Keeper of Egyptian and Assyrian Antiquities at the British Museum: his translations from Egyptian, Ethiopic and Syriac printed before 1931. The Book of the Dead (1898), the Egyptian Heaven and Hell (1905), the Liturgy of Funerary Offerings (1909), the Teaching of Amen-em-apt (1924), the Kebra Nagast (1922), the Ethiopic and Syriac Alexander romances (1896, 1889), Bar Hebraeus's Laughable Stories (1897), the Monks of Kublai Khan (1928) and the Syriac Book of Medicines (1913). His Christian translations (the Contendings of the Apostles, the Paradise of the Holy Fathers, the Ethiopic saints' lives, the Cave of Treasures) are left for lane A. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 72); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_excluded.christian-texts: Budge's Christian translations are left for lane A: The Contendings of the Apostles (1899-1901), The Paradise or Garden of the Holy Fathers (1907), Saint Michael the Archangel (1894), the Life of Takla Haymanot (1906), the Book of the Saints of the Ethiopian Church (1928) and the Book of the Cave of Treasures (1927).
_excluded.book-of-the-dead-reissues: The 1901 three-volume Books on Egypt and Chaldaea reissue of the Book of the Dead translation and the 1913 Papyrus of Ani are not added alongside the 1898 translation.
_excluded.book-of-the-dead-other-volumes: The Egyptian text and vocabulary volumes of the 1898 Book of the Dead (e.g. bookdeadanengli00budggoog, the vocabulary) are not shelved.
_excluded.book-of-medicines-1: Vol. I of the Book of Medicines (1913) is the Syriac text.
